layout: Episode 8 pack atlas, merged into npcs. Humanoid blocks (3 per band, rows down,left,right,up x cols stand,stepA,stepB,blink). No atlas `origin`: every frame uses the default bottom-centre [12,31]. npc_librarian is the Librarian (hood up, the face in shadow in every frame); npc_first_keeper is the same man with the hood back (white hair, gold eyes, the book clasp); npc_first_keeper_m his memory self (dark hair greying), npc_first_keeper_m_bundle the same carrying the baby bundle; npc_elowen is Elowen (grey at the temples, ink to the wrists, a quill behind her ear) and npc_elowen_m her younger self sitting up in an infirmary bed with the bundle (every direction shows the bed); npc_nurse_m holds the empty blanket; npc_ep8_innkeeper and npc_ep8_shopkeeper are npc_innkeeper and npc_shopkeeper recoloured. Props prop_ep8_bundle and prop_ep8_blanket are single 16x16 frames (bottom-centre), and each is also a one-direction 24x32 actor cell <id>_down_0 (the 16x16 drawing on its bottom centre).
